document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You see a sketch of a stump-like horrible 
being, and another that looks like a bubbling 
biological mass gone mad. There’s a report on 
the Lake expedition, with penciled comments 
discounting the rumored city, yet expressing 
astonishment at the odd footprints found 
and then brought back to Miskatonic 
university. Return to 460.
(460)
